title: Git-Ignoring Local Secret Files
description: A .gitignore entry that keeps local secret files out of the repository, added before the first git add.

steps.description: This is a `.gitignore` file. It lists the files Git should never track.
`.dev.vars` and `.env` hold local secrets, so they stay out of the repository.
The comment says to add these the moment the files could exist, before your first `git add`.
